rows.name: AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY
rows.read_by: CI job `weeder` (`.github/workflows/nix-build.yml`)
rows.values: Path of a directory. The text is not parsed.

rows.name: ALL_PROXY
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. The `httpx` library reads it inside `t/proxy/tools/capture.py`. `t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py` sets and removes it.
rows.values: Proxy URL. TRON code does not parse it.
rows.effect: `t/proxy/tools/capture.py` calls `httpx.post` with default settings. The `httpx` library then sends the capture requests through this proxy. The replay tests of rinzler_proxy ignore the variable.
rows.notes: The replay client fixture passes `trust_env=False`. The readiness probe of the test launcher uses `http.client` and reads no proxy variable. `t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py` sets `http://127.0.0.1:1` in one test and removes the variable in another test.

rows.name: ARCHFLAGS
rows.read_by: `make` in `bin/iotools-1.5` (`bin/iotools-1.5/Makefile`)
rows.values: Compiler flags as text. `make` inserts the text into `CFLAGS` unchanged.
rows.default: Unset: `CFLAGS` gets no extra flags from it.
rows.effect: The makefile adds the flags to `CFLAGS`. The compile and link commands of the `iotools` program use `CFLAGS`.
rows.notes: `bin/iotools-1.5` is a vendored copy of Google iotools 1.5. No TRON build file runs this makefile. The variable is used only when a person runs `make` in that directory.

rows.name: ASAN_OPTIONS
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `GNUmakefile` sets it for the AddressSanitizer run time inside the test programs of `make test-asan`.
rows.values: TRON sets the fixed text `detect_leaks=0`.
rows.effect: `make test-asan` starts 5 test programs from `gen-asan` (the AddressSanitizer build directory) with `ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=0"`. AddressSanitizer (the LLVM memory error detector) then reports no memory leaks at exit.
rows.notes: The assignment is on each of the 5 command lines. It replaces a value from the caller. A comment in `GNUmakefile` says that `t_scheduler` and `t_stream_generate_race` need FPGA cards.

rows.name: CABAL_DIR
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. 3 CI workflows set it for cabal (`.github/workflows/cmake-single-platform.yml`, `.github/workflows/cpp-coverage.yml`, `.github/workflows/ingest-coverage.yml`).
rows.values: TRON sets the path `<workspace>/.cabal`. `<workspace>` is the workspace directory of the GitHub Actions job.
rows.effect: The workflows write it to the `GITHUB_ENV` file for the later steps of the job. cabal (the Haskell build tool) then keeps its files under the job workspace.
rows.notes: `ingest-coverage.yml` also adds `$CABAL_DIR/bin` to `PATH`. It restores a cache of `<workspace>/.cabal/store`.

rows.name: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS

rows.effect: `bin/bsub-build` exports it in the remote build job. cargo (the Rust build tool) then runs at most that number of parallel jobs.

rows.name: CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `rust/run-cargo` exports it for cargo.
rows.values: TRON sets the path `$TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN/bin/rustc`.
rows.effect: When `IN_NIX_SHELL` is not empty, `rust/run-cargo` (the TRON wrapper for cargo, the Rust build tool) exports the path of the Nix `rustc` under this name. A value from the caller is replaced.
rows.notes: When `IN_NIX_SHELL` is unset or empty, `rust/run-cargo` does not change the variable, and cargo gets the caller value. The CI test `bin/ci/test-nix-rust-toolchain.sh` sets `/bin/false` to check the replacement.

rows.name: CARGO_HOME
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. 3 files set it for cargo (the Rust build tool) and rustup (`rust/rust-toolchain.sh`, `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`, `bin/ci/test_run_cargo_test_binary.py`).
rows.values: TRON sets a directory path. `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` sets `<root>/.cargo`. `<root>` is the checkout directory or `$HOME`.
rows.effect: `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` exports it before it installs or upgrades Rust with rustup (the Rust installer). It writes the same `export` line into `rust/rustenv`. `rust/run-cargo` sources that file when `IN_NIX_SHELL` is empty.
rows.notes: No TRON script reads a caller value. The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` sets `$HOME/.cargo` and copies an offline cargo configuration to `$CARGO_HOME/config.toml`. One CI test sets a temporary directory.

rows.name: CARGO_NET_OFFLINE
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix` exports it for cargo.
rows.values: TRON sets the fixed text `true`.
rows.effect: The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` exports `CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true` in its build phase. cargo (the Rust build tool) then builds the Rust libraries without network access.
rows.notes: The cargo configuration file that the same build copies to `$CARGO_HOME/config.toml` also contains `offline = true`.

rows.name: CARGO_TARGET_DIR
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `bin/ci/test_run_cargo_test_binary.py` sets it for cargo.
rows.values: TRON sets the path `<temporary directory>/cargo-target`.
rows.effect: One CI test sets it for each run of the helper `rust/run-cargo-test-binary`. cargo (the Rust build tool) then writes its build output into the temporary directory of the test.
rows.notes: No TRON build script sets or reads it.

rows.name: CC
rows.read_by: Nix builds `tron-cmake-test-build` and `cmake-sandbox-configure` (`nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`, `flake.nix`)
rows.values: Path or name of a C compiler. TRON passes the text on unchanged.
rows.default: Unset: does not occur in the 2 Nix builds. `flake.nix` sets `CC` for them.
rows.effect: `flake.nix` sets it to a clang 19 compiler in 5 Nix dev shells and in the Nix CMake builds. The 2 Nix builds pass it to CMake as `-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER`.
rows.notes: The dev shells `default`, `tools` and `cuda` set the path of a `clang-19` wrapper. `cmake-sandbox` sets the clang of the Nix LLVM 19 package. `minimal` sets `clang-19`. The CMake presets set `CMAKE_C_COMPILER` to `clang-19` and do not name `CC`.

rows.name: CCACHE_CONFIGPATH
rows.read_by: `make`, `cmake --preset` (`GNUmakefile`, `CMakePresets.json`, `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`)
rows.values: Path of a ccache configuration file. TRON does not parse the text.
rows.default: Unset: `make` exports `<checkout>/.ccache/ccache.conf`. Empty: `make` keeps the empty value.
rows.effect: `make` keeps a value from the caller and exports it to every recipe. ccache (the compiler cache) reads its configuration from this file.
rows.notes: The CMake preset `base-ninja` sets `${sourceDir}/.ccache/ccache.conf` for the configure step and replaces a caller value. The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` sets the file of its source copy when its shared cache directory is writable.

rows.name: CCACHE_DIR
rows.read_by: `make`, `cmake --preset` (`GNUmakefile`, `CMakePresets.json`, `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`)
rows.values: Path of the ccache cache directory. TRON does not parse the text.
rows.default: Unset: `make` exports `/tmp/ccache-<user>`. `<user>` is the value of `USER`. Empty: `make` keeps the empty value.
rows.effect: `make` keeps a value from the caller and exports it to every recipe. ccache (the compiler cache) stores and looks up compile results in this directory.
rows.notes: The CMake preset `base-ninja` sets `/tmp/ccache-$env{USER}` for the configure step and replaces a caller value. The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` sets `/opt/positron/.cache/ccache-nix` when that directory is writable. `bin/bsub-build` does not forward the variable to the LSF job.

rows.name: CCACHE_DISABLE
rows.read_by: `bsub-build`, `time_rebuild` (`bin/bsub-build`, `bin/time_rebuild`)
rows.values: Any text. `bin/bsub-build` tests only whether the value is empty. It forwards a non-empty value unchanged.
rows.default: Unset: `bin/bsub-build` does not export it in the LSF build job.
rows.effect: `bin/bsub-build` exports a non-empty value in the LSF build job. `bin/time_rebuild` exports `CCACHE_DISABLE=1` before its second, timed `make`. That build then runs without ccache (the compiler cache).
rows.notes: The LSF job starts from an empty environment (`env -i`). Only the variables that `bin/bsub-build` names reach the job.

evidence.quote: for var in ENABLE_FUSE_STATS CCACHE_DISABLE XDG_CACHE_HOME; do

rows.name: CCACHE_STATSLOG
rows.read_by: Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` (`nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`)
rows.values: Path of a file. TRON tests only that the file exists and is not empty.
rows.default: Unset: the build does not print ccache statistics.
rows.effect: The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` sets it to `$TMPDIR/ccache-stats.log` when it uses ccache (the compiler cache). After the build it runs `ccache --show-log-stats` when that file is not empty.
rows.notes: Set only when `/opt/positron/.cache/ccache-nix` exists and is writable. A failure of `ccache --show-log-stats` is ignored.

rows.name: CCACHE_TEMPDIR
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix` exports it for ccache.
rows.values: TRON sets the path `$TMPDIR/ccache-tmp`.
rows.effect: The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` exports it and creates the directory. ccache (the compiler cache) then keeps its temporary files inside the Nix build directory.
rows.notes: Set only when `/opt/positron/.cache/ccache-nix` exists and is writable. Otherwise the build sets no ccache variable and compiles without ccache.

rows.name: CCACHE_UMASK
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix` exports it for ccache.
rows.values: TRON sets the fixed text `002`.
rows.effect: The Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build` exports `CCACHE_UMASK=002`. ccache (the compiler cache) then creates files in the shared cache directory that the group can write.

rows.name: CI
rows.read_by: `make`, `bin/scratch-dir.sh`, `lefthook` (the Git hook runner), Nix dev shell hook (`GNUmakefile`, `bin/scratch-dir.sh`, `lefthook.yml` and 1 more file)
rows.values: Any non-empty text counts as set. The text is not parsed. The CI workflows set `true`.
rows.default: Unset: every reader treats the run as a developer run.
rows.effect: Any non-empty value marks a CI run. `bin/scratch-dir.sh` creates a plain build directory and no `/scratch` link. `lefthook` commands fail when a lint tool is missing. The Nix dev shell installs no Git hooks.
rows.notes: `make` prints its warning about running outside `nix develop` only when `CI` and `IN_NIX_SHELL` are both empty. `make lint` and the `rustfmt` hook skip a missing cargo only when both are empty. The workflows set `CI=true` before `nix develop`.

rows.name: CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM
rows.read_by: Nothing in TRON. `flake.nix` sets it for CMake.
rows.values: TRON sets the fixed text `3.5`.
rows.effect: `flake.nix` sets it in the Nix dev shells `default`, `tools`, `cuda` and `cmake-sandbox` and in the Nix CMake builds. CMake 4.x then accepts dependencies that declare an older `cmake_minimum_required` version.
rows.notes: A comment in `flake.nix` names yaml-cpp 0.8.0 and drogon as these dependencies. The CMake presets `base-ninja` and `darwin` set a CMake cache variable of the same name to `3.5`. That is not an environment variable.

rows.name: CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
rows.read_by: `cmake` configure step (`CMakeLists.txt`, `flake.nix`)
rows.values: List of install prefixes, separated by `:`. TRON tests only whether the variable is defined. TRON does not parse the text.
rows.default: Unset: TRON passes `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/lib/llvm-19` to `iwyu_external`. Empty: counts as defined, and TRON passes no such argument.
rows.effect: The root `CMakeLists.txt` checks it when it configures `iwyu_external` (the include-what-you-use external project). When it is defined, TRON passes no `CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH` argument. The sub-build then inherits the variable.
rows.notes: `flake.nix` sets a list of Nix store paths in the dev shells `default`, `tools`, `cuda` and `cmake-sandbox` and in the Nix CMake builds. On macOS `flake.nix` assigns an empty text in the first 3 shells. `iwyu_external` is excluded from the default build target.

new_terms.definition: The compiler cache. It stores compile results and reuses them in later builds.
The program that installs and updates Rust toolchains.
The Haskell build tool. It builds the ingest pipeline.
The Git hook runner. `lefthook.yml` lists the lint commands that it runs before a commit.
The TRON wrapper script that starts cargo. Inside the Nix dev shell it starts the cargo of the Nix Rust toolchain.
The Nix build that compiles TRON and its tests with CMake. `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix` defines it.
The LLVM run-time checker that detects memory errors and memory leaks.
The CMake external project that builds include-what-you-use, a tool that checks `#include` lines.
A Google tool, version 1.5. A vendored copy is in `bin/iotools-1.5`.

notes: All 24 names are kept. Source was opened for every variable. ALL_PROXY: no TRON code names it for reading. The `httpx` library reads it in the capture tool, and two tests set or remove it. The row uses tron_use "sets". CCACHE_CONFIGPATH and CCACHE_DIR: the statement that a CMake preset value replaces a caller value is CMake behaviour. No line of the checkout shows it. CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH: the statement that an empty value counts as defined is CMake behaviour of `if(DEFINED ENV{...})`. No line of the checkout shows it. CC: the default cell says that unset does not occur in the 2 Nix builds. The same Nix expressions set the value. Two evidence quotes are a part of their source line and not the whole line: `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix:138` and `bin/ci/test_run_cargo_test_binary.py:194`. The whole lines contain the pipe character, which no field may contain. The limit of 35 words for the external section is applied to every effect cell.
